title: 1984 string theory takeover, 'the only game in town'

tellings.quote: And then right up until 1984 where we get the green schwarz anomaly cancellation and Ed Whitten, Lewis Whitten's son directs the entire field uh to put its energies on one bet.

plain: In 1984, says a researcher named Eric Weinstein, theoretical physics bet nearly everything on string theory, the idea that the smallest pieces of matter are tiny vibrating strings. He says that after the Green-Schwarz anomaly cancellation, a mathematical result that made string theory look workable, the physicist Ed Witten, "Lewis Whitten's son", steered "the entire field" to "put its energies on one bet", and he also brings up Richard Feynman. He tells this without naming a source, and the point is that physics may have narrowed itself to a single path.
